message.content: {"obligations":[{"id":"DUAL_RESOURCE_SPAN","label":"C","source_lines":[9,11,15,16,19,22,23,26,27,30,31],"reason":"Each worker acquires fixture then tool, owns both during source approach/grasp, carry to target, release and departure, then releases tool then fixture; try/finally also releases acquired controllers."},{"id":"LONG_RANGE_DEPENDENCY","label":"C","source_lines":[9,11,15,16,19,22,23,26,27,30,31],"reason":"Source implements the LONG dual-resource span: both controllers acquired before pickup and held across carry, placement, and departure until after release/depart, matching the focal dependency."},{"id":"SUPPORT_DEPARTURE","label":"C","source_lines":[22,23],"reason":"Each release occurs at the declared support target (left_target/right_target) and is immediately followed by a same-arm move to depart in the same coroutine."},{"id":"TASK_GOAL","label":"V","source_lines":[55,56,57,58,59,9,11,27,31],"reason":"Both workers acquire the shared fixture and tool concurrently with the same order, so the second acquire cannot succeed while the first arm owns the resource; the concurrent workers cannot both complete placement/departure and leave both controllers OFF/unowned."},{"id":"TIMEOUT_CLEANUP","label":"C","source_lines":[8,9,10,11,12,33,34,43],"reason":"try/finally tracks fixture_owned/tool_owned and releases any successfully acquired controller after an acquisition timeout; normal path also releases both."}]}
